units.en: Biographies 67

units.zh: 郎坦朋春薩布素瑪拉
units.en: Lang Tan, Peng Chun, Sa Bu Su, and Ma La
units.literal: Lang Tan, Peng Chun, Sa Bu Su, Ma La

units.zh: 郎坦，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正白旗人，內大臣吳拜子。
units.en: Lang Tan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the son of Minister of the Imperial Household Wu Bai.
units.literal: Lang Tan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner and the son of Minister of the Imperial Household Wu Bai.

units.zh: 年十四，授三等侍衛。
units.en: At fourteen he received appointment as a third-class imperial bodyguard.
units.literal: At age fourteen he was appointed a third-class bodyguard.

units.zh: 順治六年，進二等。
units.en: In Shunzhi 6 (1649) he was promoted to second-class bodyguard.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Shunzhi he was promoted to the second class.

units.zh: 從端重親王博洛討叛將薑瓖，次渾源，圍城。
units.en: He followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo against the rebel general Jiang Xiang, encamped at Hunyuan, and laid siege to the city.
units.literal: He followed Prince Duanzhong Bolo in campaigning against the rebel general Jiang Xiang, halted at Hunyuan, and besieged the city.

units.zh: 賊渡濠來犯，郎坦射其酋，貫心，殪，遂敗賊。
units.en: When the rebels crossed the moat to attack, Lang Tan shot their leader through the heart and killed him on the spot, routing the enemy.
units.literal: The rebels crossed the moat to attack; Lang Tan shot their chieftain, the arrow piercing his heart and killing him, and thus defeated the rebels.

units.zh: 師還，進一等。
units.en: After the campaign he was promoted to first-class bodyguard.
units.literal: When the army returned he was promoted to the first class.

units.zh: 八年，以吳拜附和內大臣洛什等獲罪，並奪郎坦官。
units.en: In Shunzhi 8 (1651), when Wu Bai was condemned for siding with Minister of the Imperial Household Losi and others, Lang Tan was stripped of his post as well.
units.literal: In the eighth year, because Wu Bai had been implicated with Grand Secretary Losi and others in a crime, Lang Tan's office was also stripped away.

units.zh: 尋復之。
units.en: His rank was soon restored.
units.literal: Shortly afterward it was restored.

units.zh: 康熙二年，代吳拜管佐領，遷護軍參領。
units.en: In Kangxi 2 (1663) he succeeded Wu Bai in command of an assistant banner company and was appointed deputy commandant of the guards.
units.literal: In the second year of Kangxi he took over Wu Bai's command of an assistant banner company and was transferred to deputy commandant of the guards.

units.zh: 從定西將軍圖海討李自成餘黨李來亨等於茅麓山，深入賊巢，獲所置官十一。
units.en: He joined General Tu Hai of the Pacification of the West against Li Zicheng's remaining followers Li Laiheng and others at Maolu Mountain, pushed deep into the rebel stronghold, and captured eleven officials the rebels had appointed.
units.literal: He followed the Pacifier of the West Tu Hai in campaigning against Li Zicheng's remnant followers Li Laiheng and others at Maolu Mountain, penetrated deep into the rebel nest, and captured eleven officials they had installed.

units.zh: 四年，襲一等精奇尼哈番。
units.en: In Kangxi 4 (1665) he inherited the first-class hereditary rank of jingqini.
units.literal: In the fourth year he inherited the first-class jingqini hatang.

units.zh: 十二年，京師有陳三道者，設壇以邪教惑眾，命郎坦與諸侍衛捕治。
units.en: In Kangxi 12 (1673), a man named Chen Sandao in the capital set up an altar and led people astray with a heterodox cult; Lang Tan was ordered, with other bodyguards, to arrest him.
units.literal: In the twelfth year there was in the capital a man called Chen Sandao who set up an altar and deluded the people with heterodox teachings; Lang Tan was ordered, together with other bodyguards, to arrest and punish him.

units.zh: 十三年，命行邊，獲逋盜張飛腿等。
units.en: In Kangxi 13 (1674) he was sent on a frontier tour and captured the outlaw Zhang Feitui and his gang.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to tour the frontier and captured the fugitive bandits Zhang Feitui and others.

units.zh: 擢正白旗蒙古副都統，調本旗滿洲。
units.en: He was promoted to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain White Banner and then transferred to the Manchu wing of the same banner.
units.literal: He was promoted to Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner and transferred to the Manchu wing of his own banner.

units.zh: 順治中，俄羅斯東部人犯黑龍江邊境，時稱為羅剎。
units.en: During the Shunzhi reign, Russians from the east raided the Heilongjiang frontier and were known at court as the Luosha.
units.literal: During Shunzhi, people from eastern Russia violated the Heilongjiang border and were at the time called Luosha.

units.zh: 九年，駐防寧古塔章京海塞遣捕牲翼長希福率兵與戰，師敗績。
units.en: In Shunzhi 9 (1652), Hai Sai, military governor of the Ningguta garrison, sent Xifu, chief of a hunting-detail wing, against them; the Qing force was defeated.
units.literal: In the ninth year the garrison commander of Ningguta, Hai Sai, sent the chief of the hunting-detail wing Xifu to lead troops into battle, and the army suffered defeat.

units.zh: 世祖命誅海塞，鞭希福百，仍駐寧古塔。
units.en: The Shunzhi Emperor ordered Hai Sai put to death, had Xifu flogged one hundred strokes, and left him in post at Ningguta.
units.literal: The Shizu Emperor ordered Hai Sai executed, had Xifu flogged one hundred strokes, and left him still stationed at Ningguta.

units.zh: 十一年，固山額真明安達里率師討之，敗敵黑龍江。
units.en: In Shunzhi 11 (1654), banner general Ming Andali led troops against them and defeated the enemy on the Heilongjiang.
units.literal: In the eleventh year the banner general Ming Andali led an army to campaign against them and defeated the enemy on the Heilongjiang.

units.zh: 羅剎未大創，复侵入精奇里江諸處。
units.en: The Russians were not crippled and soon raided again along the Jingqiri River and neighboring areas.
units.literal: The Luosha were not severely wounded and again invaded the region of the Jingqiri River and elsewhere.

units.zh: 上命大理寺卿明愛等諭令撤回，遷延不即去，據雅克薩城，於其旁耕種漁獵；
units.en: The emperor sent Chief Judge Ming Ai of the Court of Judicial Review and others to order them to withdraw; they lingered, refused to leave, seized the town of Albazin (Yaksa), and farmed, fished, and hunted nearby;
units.literal: The emperor ordered the chief judge of the Court of Judicial Review Ming Ai and others to instruct them to withdraw; they delayed and did not leave at once, occupied the city of Yaksa, and farmed, fished, and hunted beside it;

units.zh: 又過牛滿、恆滾，侵擾索倫、赫哲、飛牙喀、奇勒爾諸部。
units.en: they crossed the Amur tributaries Nioman and Henggun and raided the Solon, Hezhe, Feiyaka, Qileer, and other peoples.
units.literal: they also crossed the Nioman and Henggun and harassed the Solon, Hezhe, Feiyaka, Qileer, and other tribes.

units.zh: 二十一年秋，遣郎坦及副都統朋春等率兵往索倫。
units.en: In the autumn of Kangxi 21 (1682) Lang Tan and Deputy Lieutenant-General Peng Chun were sent with troops into Solon territory.
units.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-first year Lang Tan and Deputy Lieutenant-General Peng Chun and others were dispatched to lead troops to the Solon.

units.zh: 比行，諭曰：「羅剎犯我境，恃雅克薩城為巢穴，歷年已久，殺掠不已。
units.en: Before they marched, the emperor instructed them: "The Russians have violated our border, using Albazin as their base for many years, killing and looting without end.
units.literal: Just before they set out, an edict said: "The Luosha violate our territory, relying on the city of Yaksa as their nest; for many years they have not ceased killing and plundering.

units.zh: 爾等至達呼爾、索倫，遣人往諭以來捕鹿。
units.en: When you reach the Dahur and Solon lands, send envoys announcing that you have come to hunt deer.
units.literal: When you reach Dahuer and the Solon, send men to announce that you have come to hunt deer.

units.zh: 因詳視陸路遠近，沿黑龍江行圍，迳薄雅克薩城，勘其形勢。
units.en: Use that pretext to map the land routes carefully, hunt along the Heilongjiang, approach Albazin directly, and reconnoiter its defenses.
units.literal: Thereby examine in detail the distances by land route, conduct a hunt along the Heilongjiang, press straight upon the city of Yaksa, and survey its terrain.

units.zh: 度羅剎不敢出戰，如出戰，姑勿交鋒，但率剎引退。
units.en: The Russians will probably not dare fight; if they do, do not engage for now—withdraw your force.
units.literal: It is expected that the Luosha will not dare come out to fight; if they do come out, for the moment do not join battle but lead your men to withdraw.

units.zh: 朕別有區畫。」
units.en: I have my own larger design."
units.literal: I have another plan."

units.zh: 賜御用裘服、弓矢以行。
units.en: He granted them imperial fur coats, bows, and arrows for the expedition.
units.literal: He bestowed imperial fur coats and bows and arrows for the journey.

units.zh: 及冬，郎坦等還京師，疏言：「羅剎久踞雅克薩，恃有木城。
units.en: That winter Lang Tan and his party returned to the capital and reported: "The Russians have held Albazin for years behind a wooden palisade.
units.literal: When winter came Lang Tan and the others returned to the capital and memorialized: "The Luosha have long occupied Yaksa, relying on their wooden fort.

units.zh: 若發兵三千，與紅衣砲二十，即可攻取。
units.en: Three thousand men and twenty red-barreled cannon would suffice to take it.
units.literal: If three thousand troops are sent with twenty red-coated cannon, it can be taken.

units.zh: 陸行自興安嶺以往，林木叢雜，冬雪堅冰，夏雨泥淖，惟輕裝可行。
units.en: The land route from the Greater Khingan is choked with forest; winter brings hard ice, summer deep mud—only light columns can move there.
units.literal: Going by land from the Greater Khingan Range onward, the woods are dense and tangled; in winter snow and ice are hard, in summer rain turns the ground to mud—only light equipment can pass.

units.zh: 自雅克薩還至愛滹城，於黑龍江順流行船，僅須半月，逆流行船，約須三月，倍於陸行，期於運糧餉、軍器、輜重為便。
units.en: From Albazin down the Heilongjiang to Aihun takes only half a month by boat; upstream takes about three months—twice the march by land—but water is better for grain, arms, and stores.
units.literal: From Yaksa back to Aihun city, going downstream on the Heilongjiang by boat requires only half a month; going upstream by boat takes about three months, twice the land journey, but is convenient for transporting grain, weapons, and baggage.

units.zh: 現有大船四十、小船二十六，宜增造小船五十餘應用。」
units.en: We now have forty large vessels and twenty-six small ones; fifty-odd more small boats should be built."
units.literal: There are now forty large boats and twenty-six small boats; more than fifty small boats should be built to meet needs."

units.zh: 上諭曰：「郎坦等奏攻取羅剎甚易，朕亦以為然。
units.en: The emperor replied: "Lang Tan says the Russians can be taken easily, and I agree.
units.literal: The emperor instructed: "Lang Tan and the others memorialized that taking the Luosha would be very easy, and I too think so.

units.zh: 第兵非善事，宜暫停攻取。
units.en: Yet war is never a good thing; hold off the assault for now.
units.literal: But war is no good affair; the attack should for the moment be suspended.

units.zh: 調烏拉、寧古塔兵千五百人，並製造船艦，發紅衣砲、鳥槍教之演習。
units.en: Transfer fifteen hundred men from Ula and Ningguta, build ships, issue red-barreled guns and muskets, and drill them.
units.literal: Transfer fifteen hundred troops from Ula and Ningguta, build ships as well, issue red-coated cannon and muskets, and teach them drill.

units.zh: 於愛琿、呼瑪爾二地建木城，與之對壘，相機舉行。
units.en: Build wooden forts at Aihun and Hurka to face them and strike when the moment is right.
units.literal: Erect wooden forts at Aihun and Hurka to face them in camp and act when opportunity offers.

units.zh: 所需軍糧，取諸科爾沁十旗及錫伯、烏拉官屯，約得一萬二千石，可支三年。
units.en: Grain can be drawn from the ten Khorchin banners and from Xibo and Ula government farms—about twelve thousand piculs, enough for three years.
units.literal: The grain needed for the army should be taken from the ten banners of Khorchin and from official colonies of Xibo and Ula, amounting to about twelve thousand piculs, enough to supply three years.

units.zh: 愛琿城距索倫五宿可至，其間設一驛。
units.en: Aihun is five days' march from Solon country; establish a relay station between.
units.literal: From Aihun city to the Solon is five days' march; set one courier station between.

units.zh: 俟我兵將至精奇里烏拉，令索倫供牛羊。
units.en: When our army nears Jingqiri Ula, have the Solon furnish cattle and sheep.
units.literal: When our troops are about to reach Jingqiri Ula, order the Solon to supply cattle and sheep.

units.zh: 如此，則羅剎不得納我逋逃，而彼之逋逃且絡繹來歸，自不能久存矣。」
units.en: Then the Russians cannot shelter our deserters, while theirs will stream back to us—and they cannot hold out long."
units.literal: In this way the Luosha will not be able to receive our fugitives, while their fugitives will come back in an unbroken stream, and they naturally cannot long endure."

units.zh: 尋擢郎坦前鋒統領。
units.en: Soon afterward Lang Tan was made vanguard commander.
units.literal: Shortly afterward Lang Tan was promoted to vanguard commander.

units.zh: 二十二年，命與黑龍江將軍薩布素會議，駐兵額蘇哩。
units.en: In Kangxi 22 (1683) he was ordered to consult with Heilongjiang General Sa Bu Su on garrisoning troops at Esuri.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year he was ordered to confer with Heilongjiang General Sa Bu Su and station troops at Esuri.

units.zh: 事還，奏額蘇哩七月即經霜雪，宜乘春和，以寧古塔兵分為三班，更番戍守。
units.en: On his return he reported that Esuri sees frost and snow as early as the seventh month and proposed that Ningguta troops rotate in three shifts during the milder spring season.
units.literal: When the mission returned he memorialized that at Esuri frost and snow come as early as the seventh month and that one should take advantage of spring warmth, dividing the Ningguta troops into three shifts for rotating garrison duty.

units.zh: 上以更番戍守非久長策，不允。
units.en: The emperor judged rotating garrisons no lasting solution and refused.
units.literal: The emperor held that rotating garrison duty was not a long-term policy and did not approve.

units.zh: 二十三年，甄別八旗管兵官，罷郎坦前鋒統領，以世職隨旗行走。
units.en: In Kangxi 23 (1684), during a review of banner field officers, Lang Tan was dismissed as vanguard commander and served only on his hereditary rank within his banner.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year, when banner officers commanding troops were screened, Lang Tan was removed as vanguard commander and allowed to serve with his hereditary rank in his banner.

units.zh: 二十四年，命都統朋春率師徵羅剎，郎坦以副都統銜隨徵。
units.en: In Kangxi 24 (1685) Lieutenant-General Peng Chun was ordered to campaign against the Russians; Lang Tan joined as acting deputy lieutenant-general.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Lieutenant-General Peng Chun was ordered to lead an army against the Luosha; Lang Tan followed the campaign with the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.

units.zh: 師薄雅克薩城，羅剎酋額里克舍請降，郎坦宣詔宥其罪，引眾徙去，毀木城。
units.en: When the army reached Albazin, Russian leader Alibaz surrendered; Lang Tan read the imperial pardon, evacuated the garrison, and tore down the wooden fort.
units.literal: The army pressed upon Yaksa; the Luosha chieftain Alibaz requested surrender; Lang Tan proclaimed the edict pardoning their crime, led the multitude to move away, and destroyed the wooden fort.

units.zh: 是冬羅剎復來，踞雅克薩築城。
units.en: That winter the Russians returned, reoccupied Albazin, and rebuilt the fort.
units.literal: That winter the Luosha came again, occupied Yaksa, and built a fort.

units.zh: 二十五年，命郎坦偕副都統班達爾沙攜紅衣砲，率藤牌兵百人，往會將軍薩布素進兵。
units.en: In Kangxi 25 (1686) Lang Tan and Deputy Lieutenant-General Bandarsha, with red-barreled guns and a hundred rattan-shield troops, were sent to join General Sa Bu Su's advance.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Lang Tan was ordered, together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Bandarsha carrying red-coated cannon, to lead one hundred rattan-shield troops to join General Sa Bu Su in advancing.

units.zh: 上以郎坦諳悉地勢，即令參贊軍務。
units.en: Knowing Lang Tan's familiarity with the country, the emperor made him a staff adviser on the campaign.
units.literal: Because the emperor considered Lang Tan thoroughly acquainted with the terrain, he was at once ordered to assist in military affairs.

units.zh: 六月，薄其城，鑿壕築壘，賊出拒，擊敗之，斬額里克舍。
units.en: In the sixth month they invested the town, dug trenches and breastworks; when the enemy sallied forth they were beaten back and Alibaz was killed.
units.literal: In the sixth month they pressed the city, dug trenches and built ramparts; the rebels came out to resist, were defeated, and Alibaz was beheaded.

units.zh: 尋，俄羅斯察罕汗上書請釋雅克薩圍，上許之，令郎坦撤軍，還駐寧古塔。
units.en: Soon the Russian tsar petitioned to lift the siege of Albazin; the emperor agreed, ordered Lang Tan to withdraw, and posted him again at Ningguta.
units.literal: Shortly afterward the Russian Tsar Khan sent a letter asking that the siege of Yaksa be lifted; the emperor consented, ordered Lang Tan to withdraw the army, and return to garrison Ningguta.

units.zh: 尋擢正白旗蒙古都統。
units.en: He was soon promoted to lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain White Banner.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he was promoted to Mongol lieutenant-general of the Plain White Banner.

units.zh: 二十八年，上遣內大臣索額圖等與俄羅斯使人費耀多囉等會於尼布楚，立約定界，命郎坦與議，乃毀所築城徙去。
units.en: In Kangxi 28 (1689) Minister of the Imperial Household Songgotu met Russian envoys led by Fyodor at Nerchinsk to fix the border; Lang Tan joined the talks, after which the Russian posts were dismantled and the garrisons withdrawn.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year the emperor sent Grand Secretary Songgotu and others to meet the Russian envoys Feodor and others at Nerchinsk to establish a treaty fixing the border; Lang Tan was ordered to take part in the negotiations, and then the forts they had built were destroyed and they moved away.

units.zh: 二十九年，古北口外盜起，命郎坦偕侍衛赫濟爾亨等督兵捕剿，盡殲之。
units.en: In Kangxi 29 (1690), when bandits appeared beyond Gubeikou Pass, Lang Tan and Bodyguard Hejierheng led troops against them and wiped them out.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year bandits rose outside Gubeikou; Lang Tan was ordered, together with bodyguard Hejierheng and others, to supervise troops in pursuit and extermination, and they were all destroyed.

units.zh: 三十一年，噶爾丹侵喀爾喀部，擾及邊境，授郎坦安北將軍，率師駐大同。
units.en: In Kangxi 31 (1692), when Galdan invaded the Khalkha and threatened the frontier, Lang Tan was made Pacifier of the North and encamped at Datong.
units.literal: In the thirty-first year Galdan invaded the Khalkha tribes and disturbed the border; Lang Tan was appointed Pacifier of the North and led an army stationed at Datong.

units.zh: 疏請出邊駐喀喇穆倫偵寇，詔暫駐歸化城。
units.en: He asked to advance to Karamuren on the frontier to scout the enemy; the court ordered him to hold at Guihua for the time being.
units.literal: He memorialized asking to go beyond the border and station at Karamuren to watch for the enemy; an edict ordered him to remain temporarily at Guihua city.

units.zh: 尋擢領侍衛內大臣，兼火器營總管，列議政大臣。
units.en: He was soon made chief commandant of the imperial bodyguards (ling shiwei nei dachen), superintendent of the Firearms Brigade, and a grand councillor.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he was promoted to chief commandant of the bodyguards and grand secretary, concurrently superintendent of the Firearms Brigade, and enrolled among the grand councillors.

units.zh: 三十二年，授昭武將軍，率師駐甘州。
units.en: In Kangxi 32 (1693) he was named Illustrious Martial General and took command at Ganzhou.
units.literal: In the thirty-second year he was appointed Illustrious Martial General and led an army stationed at Ganzhou.

units.zh: 三十三年，移駐寧夏，與甘肅提督孫思克分道偵寇。
units.en: In Kangxi 33 (1694) he shifted to Ningxia and, with Gansu commander Sun Sike, patrolled on separate routes.
units.literal: In the thirty-third year he moved his station to Ningxia and, together with Gansu Provincial Commander Sun Sike, divided forces to scout the enemy.

units.zh: 上聞噶爾丹將逼圖拉，命郎坦移兵禦剿，以圖拉無警，引還。
units.en: Hearing that Galdan was marching on Tüla, the emperor ordered Lang Tan forward; when Tüla proved secure he withdrew.
units.literal: The emperor heard that Galdan was about to press upon Tüla and ordered Lang Tan to move troops to resist; as Tüla was without alarm he led them back.

units.zh: 仍任領侍衛內大臣，列議政如故。
units.en: He retained his posts as chief commandant of the imperial bodyguards and grand councillor.
units.literal: He still held the post of chief commandant of the bodyguards and grand secretary and remained among the grand councillors as before.

units.zh: 三十四年，往盛京巡閱邊隘，還入塞，疾劇，遣太醫馳驛往視。
units.en: In Kangxi 34 (1695) he inspected frontier posts in the Shengjing region; falling seriously ill on his return, the court sent an imperial physician by relay post.
units.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he went to Shengjing to inspect the border passes; on returning inside the pass he fell gravely ill, and an imperial physician was dispatched post-haste to attend him.

units.zh: 尋卒，賜祭葬。
units.en: He soon died and was granted state funeral honors.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he died and was granted sacrificial rites and burial honors.

units.zh: 朋春，棟鄂氏，滿洲正紅旗人，何和禮四世孫。
units.en: Peng Chun, of the Donggo clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner and a fourth-generation descendant of He Heli.
units.literal: Peng Chun, of the Donggo clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner and a fourth-generation descendant of He Heli.

units.zh: 何和禮子和碩圖，進爵三等公；
units.en: He Heli's son Heshotu was raised to third-rank duke;
units.literal: Hešeri's son Heshotu was advanced to third-rank duke;

units.zh: 子何爾本、哲爾本、蘇布遞襲，至袞布，以恩詔進一等。
units.en: his sons He'erben, Zhe'erben, and Subu inherited in turn, until Gunbu was promoted to first-rank duke by grace edict.
units.literal: his sons He'erben, Zhe'erben, and Subu inherited in succession, down to Gunbu, who by grace edict was advanced to the first rank.

units.zh: 朋春，哲爾本子也，順治九年，襲封。
units.en: Peng Chun was Zhe'erben's son and inherited the title in Shunzhi 9 (1652).
units.literal: Peng Chun was the son of Zhe'erben; in the ninth year of Shunzhi he inherited the title.

units.zh: 康熙十五年，加太子太保，授正紅旗蒙古副都統，調本旗滿洲。
units.en: In Kangxi 15 (1676) he received the additional title Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent, became deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Red Banner, and was transferred to its Manchu wing.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year of Kangxi he was given the additional title of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and appointed Mongol deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner, then transferred to the Manchu wing of his banner.

units.zh: 二十一年，偕郎坦率兵至黑龍江覘羅剎形勢，賜御用裘服、弓矢。
units.en: In Kangxi 21 (1682) he joined Lang Tan on the Heilongjiang reconnaissance against the Russians and received imperial fur coats, bows, and arrows.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, together with Lang Tan, he led troops to the Heilongjiang to reconnoiter the Luosha situation and was granted imperial fur coats and bows and arrows.

units.zh: 與郎坦還奏，上命寧古塔將軍巴海、副都統薩布素，建木城於黑龍江、呼瑪爾，調取所部兵一千五百人往駐焉。
units.en: On their return the emperor ordered Ningguta General Bahai and Deputy Lieutenant-General Sa Bu Su to build wooden forts on the Heilongjiang and at Hurka and posted fifteen hundred of their troops there.
units.literal: Together with Lang Tan he returned and reported; the emperor ordered Ningguta General Bahai and Deputy Lieutenant-General Sa Bu Su to build wooden forts on the Heilongjiang and at Hurka and transferred fifteen hundred troops from their commands to garrison them.

units.zh: 又命尚書伊桑阿赴寧古塔督造戰船。
units.en: Minister Yisang'a was also sent to Ningguta to supervise building warships.
units.literal: He also ordered Minister Yisang'a to go to Ningguta to supervise construction of warships.

units.zh: 尋擢朋春正紅旗滿洲副都統。
units.en: Peng Chun was soon made deputy lieutenant-general of the Manchu Plain Red Banner.
units.literal: Shortly afterward Peng Chun was promoted to Manchu deputy lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner.

units.zh: 二十四年，詔選八旗及安置山東、河南、山西三省福建投誠藤牌兵，付左都督何祐率赴盛京，命朋春統之，進剿羅剎，以副都統班達爾沙、副都統銜瑪拉、鑾儀使建義侯林興珠、護軍統領佟寶參贊軍務，祐、興珠皆鄭氏將來降者也。
units.en: In Kangxi 24 (1685) the court selected banner troops and Fujian rattan-shield men settled in Shandong, Henan, and Shanxi, placed them under Left Commander He You for transfer to Shengjing, and gave Peng Chun overall command against the Russians, with Bandarsha, Ma La (acting deputy lieutenant-general), Ceremonial Director Marquis Lin Xingzhu, and Guard Commandant Tong Bao as staff advisers—He You and Lin Xingzhu were former Zheng generals who had surrendered.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year an edict selected troops from the Eight Banners and rattan-shield soldiers of Fujian who had surrendered and been settled in the three provinces of Shandong, Henan, and Shanxi, placed them under Left Commander He You to lead to Shengjing, and ordered Peng Chun to command them in advancing against the Luosha, with Deputy Lieutenant-General Bandarsha, Ma La with the rank of deputy lieutenant-general, Director of Ceremonial Jianyi Marquis Lin Xingzhu, and Guard Commandant Tong Bao to assist in military affairs; He You and Lin Xingzhu were both former generals of the Zheng who had come over in surrender.

units.zh: 師既行，上遣侍衛關保至黑龍江傳諭曰：「兵凶戰危，朕以仁治天下，素不嗜殺。
units.en: After the army marched, Bodyguard Guanbao was sent to the Heilongjiang with orders: "War is perilous; I rule by benevolence and do not love bloodshed.
units.literal: After the army had set out the emperor sent bodyguard Guanbao to the Heilongjiang with instructions: "War is inauspicious and battle perilous; I govern the realm with benevolence and by nature do not delight in killing.

units.zh: 以我兵馬精強，器械堅利，羅剎勢不能敵，必獻地歸誠。
units.en: Our troops are strong and our arms superior; the Russians cannot stand against us and will surely submit.
units.literal: With our troops and horses elite and our weapons stout and sharp, the Luosha by force cannot resist and will surely offer their land and return in allegiance.

units.zh: 爾時勿殺一人，俾還故土，宣朕柔遠至意。」
units.en: When that happens, kill no one; send them home and proclaim my wish to cherish those afar."
units.literal: At that time do not kill a single man; let them return to their native soil and proclaim my utmost intent to treat the distant with gentleness."

units.zh: 五月，師薄雅克薩城，遣人諭降，不從。
units.en: In the fifth month the army reached Albazin and sent envoys demanding surrender; the garrison refused.
units.literal: In the fifth month the army pressed Yaksa city, sent men to summon surrender, and they did not comply.

units.zh: 分水陸兵為兩路，列營夾攻，复移紅衣砲於前，積薪城下，示將焚焉。
units.en: Land and river columns attacked from two sides; red-barreled guns were brought up and brush piled against the walls as if to burn the town.
units.literal: Land and water forces were divided into two routes, camps were set to attack from both sides, red-coated cannon were again moved forward, and firewood was piled below the wall to show that it would be burned.

units.zh: 羅剎頭目額里克舍詣軍前乞降，乃宥其罪，釋還俘虜，額里克舍引六百餘人徙去，毀木城，以歸附巴什裡等四十五戶及被掠索倫、達呼爾百餘戶安插內地。
units.en: Russian leader Alibaz came out to surrender; the court pardoned them, freed prisoners, and Alibaz withdrew with six hundred-odd followers after destroying the fort; forty-five Bashili households that had submitted and more than a hundred Solon and Dahur families carried off by the Russians were resettled inland.
units.literal: The Luosha leader Alibaz came before the army to beg surrender; their crime was pardoned, captives were released, Alibaz led more than six hundred people to move away and destroyed the wooden fort, and the forty-five households of Bashili and others who had submitted and the more than one hundred Solon and Dahur households who had been carried off were resettled within the interior.

units.zh: 二十九年，厄魯特與喀爾喀構釁，命裕親王福全為撫遠大將軍，出邊剿噶爾丹，以朋春與都統蘇努參贊軍務。
units.en: In Kangxi 29 (1690), when Oirat and Khalkha clashed, Prince Yu Fuquan was made Grand General for the Pacification of the Distant to campaign against Galdan, with Peng Chun and Lieutenant-General Sunu as staff advisers.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year the Oirat and the Khalkha came into conflict; Prince Yu Fuquan was appointed Grand General for the Pacification of the Distant and sent beyond the border to campaign against Galdan, with Peng Chun and Lieutenant-General Sunu to assist in military affairs.

units.zh: 蘇努率左翼，朋春率右翼，至烏闌布通。
units.en: Sunu commanded the left wing and Peng Chun the right at Ulan Butong.
units.literal: Sunu led the left wing and Peng Chun the right wing to Ulan Butong.

units.zh: 噶爾丹依山列陣，朋春所部為泥淖所阻，蘇努督兵衝擊，大破之。
units.en: Galdan formed on the hills; Peng Chun's wing was bogged in mud, but Sunu led a charge that routed the enemy.
units.literal: Galdan drew up his line along the hills; Peng Chun's division was blocked by mud and mire, but Sunu supervised the troops in a charge and inflicted a great defeat.

units.zh: 噶爾丹偽乞和，夜自大磧山遁走。
units.en: Galdan pretended to sue for peace and fled by night over Great Shamo Mountain.
units.literal: Galdan feigned seeking peace and by night fled away over Great Shamo Mountain.

units.zh: 部議朋春坐奪官，上命寬之，降級留任。
units.en: The ministry recommended stripping Peng Chun of office; the emperor showed mercy, demoted him, and kept him in post.
units.literal: The ministry proposed that Peng Chun be punished by stripping his office; the emperor ordered leniency and demotion in rank while retaining his post.

units.zh: 三十一年，命解職赴西路軍前管隊。
units.en: In Kangxi 31 (1692) he was relieved of rank and sent to the western army to command a detachment.
units.literal: In the thirty-first year he was ordered to resign his office and go to the western-route army front to manage a detachment.

units.zh: 三十五年，复授正紅旗蒙古都統。
units.en: In Kangxi 35 (1696) he was again made lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Red Banner.
units.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he was again appointed Mongol lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner.

units.zh: 旋以費揚古為撫遠大將軍，朋春仍參贊軍務，出西路，破噶爾丹於昭莫多。
units.en: When Fiyanggū became Grand General for the Pacification of the Distant, Peng Chun again served on his staff on the western route and helped defeat Galdan at Jao Modo.
units.literal: Shortly afterward, with Fiyanggū as Grand General for the Pacification of the Distant, Peng Chun still assisted in military affairs, took the western route, and defeated Galdan at Jao Modo.

units.zh: 師還，以本隊護軍驍騎十八人戰死未收其骸，下部議。
units.en: On the return march, eighteen guard cavalry of his command had fallen without recovery of their bodies; the case went to the ministry.
units.literal: When the army returned, because eighteen guard cavalry of his own detachment had died in battle and their bodies had not been recovered, the matter was referred to the ministry for deliberation.

units.zh: 以師有功，免罪，仍錄戰績，增註敕書。
units.en: Because the campaign succeeded, he was pardoned, his battle honors recorded, and his patent of appointment amended.
units.literal: Because the army had merit, he was pardoned, his battle record was still entered, and additions were made to his patent of appointment.

units.zh: 三十八年，因病解職。
units.en: In Kangxi 38 (1699) he resigned on grounds of illness.
units.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he resigned his office because of illness.

units.zh: 尋卒。
units.en: He died soon after.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he died.

units.zh: 子增壽，改襲三等公。
units.en: His son Zengshou succeeded by altered inheritance as third-rank duke.
units.literal: His son Zengshou changed inheritance to third-rank duke.

units.zh: 薩布素，富察氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。
units.en: Sa Bu Su, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
units.literal: Sa Bu Su, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

units.zh: 四世祖充順巴本，以勇力聞，世為岳克通鄂城長。
units.en: His fourth-generation ancestor Chongshun Baben was famed for valor and for generations had been chief of Yueketong'e.
units.literal: His fourth-generation ancestor Chongshun Baben was famed for courage and strength and for generations was chief of Yueketong'e city.

units.zh: 太祖時，其後人哈木都率所部來歸，屯吉林，遂家焉。
units.en: Under Taizu, his descendant Hamudu submitted with his people, was settled at Jilin, and the family made its home there.
units.literal: In the time of the Taizu, his descendant Hamudu led his tribe to submit, was settled at Jilin, and there made his home.

units.zh: 薩布素自領催授驍騎校，遷協領。
units.en: Sa Bu Su rose from company command to vanguard captain and then assistant banner colonel.
units.literal: Sa Bu Su himself, from company command, was appointed vanguard captain and transferred to assistant banner colonel.

units.zh: 康熙十六年，聖祖遣內大臣覺羅武默訥等瞻禮長白山，至吉林，欲得識路者導引。
units.en: In Kangxi 16 (1677) the Kangxi Emperor sent Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Aisin Gioro Wumuna and others to worship at Mount Changbai; at Jilin they needed a guide who knew the way.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year of Kangxi the Sacred Ancestor sent Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Aisin Gioro Wumuna and others to pay homage at Mount Changbai; when they reached Jilin they wished to find someone who knew the route to guide them.

units.zh: 寧古塔將軍巴海令薩布素率兵二百，攜三月糧以從。
units.en: Ningguta General Bahai ordered Sa Bu Su to lead two hundred men with three months' rations as escort.
units.literal: Ningguta General Bahai ordered Sa Bu Su to lead two hundred troops and carry three months' provisions to accompany them.

units.zh: 水陸行，至長白山麓，成禮而還，事具武默訥傳。
units.en: They traveled by land and water to the foot of Mount Changbai, performed the rites, and returned; the full account appears in Wumuna's biography.
units.literal: They traveled by land and water to the foot of Mount Changbai, completed the rites, and returned; the affair is fully recorded in Wumuna's biography.

units.zh: 十七年，授薩布素寧古塔副都統。
units.en: In Kangxi 17 (1678) he was appointed deputy lieutenant-general of Ningguta.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year Sa Bu Su was appointed deputy lieutenant-general of Ningguta.

units.zh: 羅剎據雅克薩，二十一年，詔率兵偕郎坦等勘視雅克薩城形勢，並往視自額蘇哩至黑龍江及通寧古塔水陸道。
units.en: With the Russians holding Albazin, in Kangxi 21 (1682) he was ordered to join Lang Tan in reconnoitering Albazin and the land and water routes from Esuri to the Heilongjiang and Ningguta.
units.literal: The Luosha held Yaksa; in the twenty-first year an edict ordered him to lead troops together with Lang Tan and others to survey the terrain of Yaksa city and also to inspect the land and water routes from Esuri to the Heilongjiang and on to Ningguta.

units.zh: 尋郎坦還奏羅剎可圖狀，命建木城於黑龍江、呼瑪爾兩地，以巴海與薩布素統寧古塔兵千五百人往駐，造船備砲。
units.en: When Lang Tan reported that the Russians could be taken, the court ordered wooden forts on the Heilongjiang and at Hurka; Bahai and Sa Bu Su were to command fifteen hundred Ningguta troops there, build ships, and ready cannon.
units.literal: Shortly afterward Lang Tan returned and memorialized that the Luosha could be dealt with; an order was issued to build wooden forts at the Heilongjiang and Hurka, with Bahai and Sa Bu Su commanding fifteen hundred Ningguta troops to garrison them, build ships, and prepare cannon.

units.zh: 二十二年，疏言：「黑龍江、呼瑪爾距雅克薩尚遠，若駐兵兩處，則勢分道阻，且過雅克薩有尼布楚等城。
units.en: In Kangxi 22 (1683) he memorialized: "Aihun and Hurka are still far from Albazin; garrisoning both splits our force and blocks the roads, and beyond Albazin lie Nerchinsk and other Russian posts.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year he memorialized: "The Heilongjiang and Hurka are still far from Yaksa; if troops are stationed at both places, strength will be divided and routes blocked, and beyond Yaksa there are Nerchinsk and other towns.

units.zh: 羅剎倘水陸運糧，增兵救援，更難為計。
units.en: If the Russians supply by river and road and reinforce, our position grows worse.
units.literal: If the Luosha transport grain by land and water and send reinforcements, it will be even harder to manage.

units.zh: 宜乘其積貯未備，速行征剿。
units.en: We should attack before their stores are ready.
units.literal: We should strike while their stores are not yet prepared and campaign quickly.

units.zh: 俟造船畢，度七月初旬能抵雅克薩，即統兵直薄城下。」
units.en: When the fleet is ready, I expect to reach Albazin in early the seventh month and invest the town at once."
units.literal: When shipbuilding is finished, estimating that we can reach Yaksa in the first ten days of the seventh month, I shall lead the troops straight to the foot of the wall."

units.zh: 疏下王大臣議，如所請，上不許。
units.en: The memorial went to the princes and ministers, who approved his plan; the emperor refused.
units.literal: The memorial was sent down to the princes and grand ministers for deliberation; they approved as requested, but the emperor did not consent.

units.zh: 尋命巴海留守吉林，以薩布素偕寧古塔副都統瓦禮祜率兵駐額蘇哩。
units.en: Bahai was left to guard Jilin while Sa Bu Su and Ningguta Deputy Lieutenant-General Walihu garrisoned Esuri.
units.literal: Shortly afterward Bahai was ordered to remain at Jilin on guard, and Sa Bu Su together with Ningguta Deputy Lieutenant-General Walihu were to lead troops stationed at Esuri.

units.zh: 額蘇哩在黑龍江、呼瑪爾之間，為進攻雅克薩要地，有田隴舊跡。
units.en: Esuri lies between the Heilongjiang and Hurka on the road to Albazin and still shows old field traces.
units.literal: Esuri lies between the Heilongjiang and Hurka and is a strategic point for attacking Yaksa; there are traces of old fields.

units.zh: 薩布素因移達呼爾防兵五百人赴其地耕種，並請調寧古塔兵三千更番戍守。
units.en: Sa Bu Su moved five hundred Dahur garrison troops there to farm and asked for three thousand Ningguta men in rotating shifts.
units.literal: Sa Bu Su therefore transferred five hundred Dahur garrison troops to that place to farm and also requested that three thousand Ningguta troops be rotated in shifts for garrison duty.

units.zh: 上念兵丁更戍勞苦，命在黑龍江建城，備攻具，設斥堠，計程置驛，運糧積貯，設將軍、副都統領之。
units.en: Mindful of the hardship of rotation, the emperor ordered a fortress on the Heilongjiang with siege gear, outposts, relay stations, grain depots, and a general with deputy lieutenant-generals to command.
units.literal: The emperor, mindful of the hardship of rotating garrison duty for the soldiers, ordered a city built on the Heilongjiang, siege equipment prepared, outposts set, relay stations placed by measured stages, grain transported and stored, and a general and deputy lieutenant-general appointed to command.

units.zh: 擢薩布素為黑龍江將軍，招撫羅剎降人，授以官職，更令轉相招撫。
units.en: Sa Bu Su was made Heilongjiang General, enrolled surrendered Russians in office, and ordered them to bring in others.
units.literal: Sa Bu Su was promoted to Heilongjiang General, won over Luosha who surrendered, granted them offices, and further ordered them to win over others in turn.

units.zh: 上命都統瓦山、侍郎果丕與薩布素議師期，薩布素請以來年四月水陸並進，攻雅克薩城，不克，則刈其田禾。
units.en: Lieutenant-General Washan and Vice Minister Guobi were sent to fix the campaign schedule with Sa Bu Su, who proposed a joint land-and-river advance in the fourth month of the coming year on Albazin, cutting the fields if the town held.
units.literal: The emperor ordered Lieutenant-General Washan and Vice Minister Guobi to consult with Sa Bu Su on the campaign schedule; Sa Bu Su requested that in the fourth month of the coming year land and water forces advance together to attack Yaksa city, and if it were not taken, to cut their standing grain.

units.zh: 上謂攻羅剎當期必克，倘謀事草率，將益肆猖狂。
units.en: The emperor said an attack on the Russians must be planned to succeed; rash action would only make them bolder.
units.literal: The emperor said that in attacking the Luosha one must plan for certain victory; if the planning is rash, they will grow even more arrogant and reckless.

units.zh: 二十四年，以朋春等統兵進攻，薩布素會師，克雅克薩城，乃命薩布素移駐墨爾根，建城防禦。
units.en: In Kangxi 24 (1685), when Peng Chun led the assault, Sa Bu Su joined him and took Albazin; Sa Bu Su was then posted to Mergen to build a defensive town.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, with Peng Chun and others commanding the advance, Sa Bu Su joined forces, took Yaksa city, and was then ordered to move his station to Mergen and build a city for defense.

units.zh: 二十五年，疏言羅剎复踞雅克薩，請督修戰艦，俟冰泮進剿。
units.en: In Kangxi 25 (1686) he reported the Russians had reoccupied Albazin and asked to rebuild warships for a spring campaign when the ice broke.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he memorialized that the Luosha had again occupied Yaksa and requested supervision of repairing warships to campaign when the ice broke.

units.zh: 上遣郎中滿丕往诇得實，乃命薩布素暫停墨爾根兵丁遷移家口，速修戰監，率寧古塔兵二千人往攻。
units.en: Director Manpi confirmed the report; Sa Bu Su was told to halt family relocations from Mergen, hurry warship repairs, and lead two thousand Ningguta troops against Albazin.
units.literal: The emperor sent Director Manpi to reconnoiter and confirm the facts, then ordered Sa Bu Su temporarily to halt moving families of the Mergen garrison, quickly repair warships, and lead two thousand Ningguta troops to attack.

units.zh: 又命郎坦、班達爾沙會師，抵雅克薩城。
units.en: Lang Tan and Bandarsha were ordered to join him at Albazin.
units.literal: Lang Tan and Bandarsha were also ordered to join forces and reach Yaksa city.

units.zh: 城西瀕江，薩布素令於城三面掘壕築壘為長圍，對江駐水師，未冰時泊舟東西岸，截尼布楚援兵，冰時藏舟上流汊港內；
units.en: The town's west face lay on the river; Sa Bu Su dug trenches and built breastworks on three sides in a long siege line, posted the fleet on the river, anchored boats on both banks before freeze-up to block Nerchinsk reinforcements, and hid them in upstream creeks in winter;
units.literal: The west of the city borders the river; Sa Bu Su ordered trenches dug and ramparts built on three sides for a long encirclement, the river fleet stationed opposite, boats moored on both east and west banks before the ice, to cut off Nerchinsk reinforcements, and when frozen the boats hidden in upstream inlets;

units.zh: 馬有疲羸者，分發墨爾根、黑龍江飼秣，計持久。
units.en: tired horses were sent to Mergen and the Heilongjiang to be rested and fed, preparing for a long siege.
units.literal: horses that were worn or weak were sent in batches to Mergen and the Heilongjiang to be fed and rested, planning for a prolonged siege.

units.zh: 上因荷蘭貢使以書諭俄羅斯察罕汗，答書請遣使畫界，先釋雅克薩圍，上允之，命撤圍。
units.en: A Dutch tribute envoy had written the Russian tsar; Russia replied asking to send envoys to fix the border and to lift the Albazin siege first; the emperor agreed and ordered the investment raised.
units.literal: Because a Dutch tribute envoy had written to instruct the Russian Tsar Khan, a reply asked to send envoys to fix the border and first lift the siege of Yaksa; the emperor consented and ordered the siege raised.

units.zh: 二十八年，俄羅斯使臣費耀多囉等至尼布楚，命內大臣索額圖等往會，令發黑龍江兵千五百人為衛。
units.en: In Kangxi 28 (1689), when Russian envoys led by Fyodor reached Nerchinsk, Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Songgotu was sent to meet them with fifteen hundred Heilongjiang troops as guard.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year the Russian envoys Feodor and others arrived at Nerchinsk; Grand Minister of the Imperial Household Songgotu and others were ordered to meet them, and fifteen hundred Heilongjiang troops were sent as escort.

units.zh: 尋議以大興安嶺及格爾必齊河為界，毀雅克薩城，徙其人去。
units.en: The border was set at the Greater Khingan and the Gorbitsa River; Albazin was demolished and its people removed.
units.literal: Shortly afterward it was agreed to take the Greater Khingan Range and the Gorbitsa River as the border, destroy Yaksa city, and move its people away.

units.zh: 二十九年，薩布素入覲，賜賚優渥，命坐內大臣班。
units.en: In Kangxi 29 (1690) Sa Bu Su came to court, received lavish gifts, and was seated in the rank of the Grand Ministers of the Imperial Household.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Sa Bu Su came to audience; generous gifts were bestowed and he was ordered to sit in the rank of the Grand Ministers of the Imperial Household.

units.zh: 尋命總管索倫等部貢物，疏陳各部生計土俗採捕之事，擬為則例以上，上悉允行。
units.en: He was then put in charge of Solon tribute, memorialized on tribal livelihoods and customs, drafted regulations, and the emperor approved them all.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he was ordered to take charge of tribute goods from the Solon and other tribes; he memorialized on each tribe's livelihood, customs, and hunting and gathering, drafted regulations, and submitted them; the emperor approved all.

units.zh: 三十一年，奏建齊齊哈爾及白都訥城，以科爾沁部獻進錫伯、卦爾察、達呼爾壯丁萬四千有奇分駐二城，編佐領，隸上三旗，並設防守尉、防禦等官。
units.en: In Kangxi 31 (1692) he proposed building Qiqihar and Baidune; over fourteen thousand Xibo, Guarca, and Dahur men presented by Khorchin were split between the two posts, organized into companies under the Upper Three Banners, with garrison and defense officers appointed.
units.literal: In the thirty-first year he memorialized to build the cities of Qiqihar and Baidune; more than fourteen thousand strong men of Xibo, Guarca, and Dahur presented by the Khorchin were divided between the two cities, organized into assistant banner companies subordinate to the Upper Three Banners, and garrison commandants and defense officers were established.

units.zh: 噶爾丹入犯，疏陳進兵事宜，略言：「興安嶺北形勝地，以索約爾濟山為最。
units.en: When Galdan invaded he outlined the advance, saying: "Of strong points north of the Khingan Range, Suoyorji Mountain is the best.
units.literal: When Galdan invaded he memorialized on advancing troops, stating in brief: "Of the strategic places north of the Khingan Range, Suoyorji Mountain is foremost.

units.zh: 已遣識路官兵自盛京、吉林、墨爾根審度至山遠近，分置驛站，其無水處，掘井以待。
units.en: I have sent route-finders from Shengjing, Jilin, and Mergen to measure distances, set relay stations, and dig wells where water is lacking.
units.literal: I have already sent officers who know the routes from Shengjing, Jilin, and Mergen to measure the distance to the mountain, set relay stations in sections, and where there is no water, dig wells in readiness.

units.zh: 山之東北呼倫貝爾等處有警，與臣駐軍地近，即率墨爾根兵先進，吉林、盛京繼之；
units.en: If alarm comes from Hulun Buir northeast of the mountain, near my post, I shall lead Mergen troops first and Jilin and Shengjing follow;
units.literal: If there is alarm northeast of the mountain in Hulun Buir and elsewhere, close to my garrison, I shall lead the Mergen troops forward first and Jilin and Shengjing follow;

units.zh: 山之西烏勒輝等處有警，則盛京兵先進，臣率部下及吉林兵繼之：皆會於索約爾濟山。」
units.en: if from Ulehui west of the mountain, Shengjing goes first and I follow with my command and Jilin troops—all to meet at Suoyorji Mountain."
units.literal: if alarm comes from the west at Ulehui and elsewhere, Shengjing troops advance first and I lead my subordinates and Jilin troops after: all converging at Suoyorji Mountain."

units.zh: 上可其奏。
units.en: The emperor approved.
units.literal: The emperor approved his memorial.

units.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，自獨石口出中路，大將軍費揚古自歸化城出西路，命薩布素扼其東路，督盛京、寧古塔、科爾沁兵，自索約爾濟山剋期進剿。
units.en: In Kangxi 35 (1696) the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan from Dushikou on the center route while Grand General Fiyanggū marched from Guihua on the west; Sa Bu Su was to block the east with Shengjing, Ningguta, and Khorchin troops advancing from Suoyorji Mountain on schedule.
units.literal: In the thirty-fifth year the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan, taking the center route from Dushikou, Grand General Fiyanggū the western route from Guihua city; Sa Bu Su was ordered to block the eastern route, supervising Shengjing, Ningguta, and Khorchin troops to advance on schedule from Suoyorji Mountain.

units.zh: 四月，上次克魯倫河，噶爾丹西竄，為費揚古所敗。
units.en: In the fourth month the emperor halted at the Kerulen; Galdan fled west and was beaten by Fiyanggū.
units.literal: In the fourth month the emperor halted at the Kerulen River; Galdan fled west and was defeated by Fiyanggū.

units.zh: 詔分薩布素所部兵五百人隸費揚古軍。
units.en: Five hundred of Sa Bu Su's men were assigned to Fiyanggū's command.
units.literal: An edict detached five hundred of Sa Bu Su's troops to Fiyanggū's army.

units.zh: 三十六年，召至京師，尋命回任。
units.en: In Kangxi 36 (1697) he was called to Beijing and soon sent back to his post.
units.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he was summoned to the capital and shortly afterward ordered back to his post.

units.zh: 初，邊境有墨爾哲勒屯長，累世輸貢。
units.en: On the frontier there had long been Mo'erzhele village chiefs who paid tribute for generations.
units.literal: Earlier on the border there were village chiefs of Mo'erzhele who for generations paid tribute.

units.zh: 康熙初，屯長扎努喀布克托請率眾內移，寧古塔將軍巴海安輯於墨爾根，編四十佐領，號新滿洲。
units.en: Early in Kangxi, chief Zanukabukto asked to move his people inward; Ningguta General Bahai settled them at Mergen in forty companies called the New Manchus.
units.literal: At the beginning of Kangxi the village chief Zanukabukto asked to lead his people to move inward; Ningguta General Bahai settled them at Mergen, organized forty assistant banner companies, and called them New Manchus.

units.zh: 薩布素奏於墨爾根兩翼立學，設助教，選新滿洲及錫伯、索倫、達呼爾每佐領下幼童一，教習書義。
units.en: Sa Bu Su proposed schools at Mergen on both wings with assistant teachers and one boy per company from the New Manchus, Xibo, Solon, and Dahur to learn reading.
units.literal: Sa Bu Su memorialized to establish schools on both wings at Mergen, set assistant teachers, and select one young boy from each assistant company of New Manchus, Xibo, Solon, and Dahur to be taught the meaning of books.

units.zh: 是為黑龍江建學之始。
units.en: This was the beginning of schools in the Heilongjiang region.
units.literal: This was the beginning of establishing schools in the Heilongjiang region.

units.zh: 三十七年，上幸吉林，褒其勤勞，予一等阿達哈哈番世職，並御用冠服，於眾前宣諭賜之。
units.en: In Kangxi 37 (1698) the emperor visited Jilin, praised his service, granted a first-class ada hahapan hereditary rank and imperial robes, and announced the gifts before the court.
units.literal: In the thirty-seventh year the emperor visited Jilin, praised his diligence, granted a first-class ada hahapan hereditary rank, and imperial caps and robes, proclaiming and bestowing them before the assembly.

units.zh: 尋疏言黑龍江屯堡因災荒積欠米石，請俟年豐交倉。
units.en: He soon reported that Heilongjiang garrison farms owed grain from famine years and asked to repay when harvests were good.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he memorialized that Heilongjiang garrison colonies owed accumulated grain because of famine and asked to deliver to the granary when the year was abundant.

units.zh: 上以薩布素曾奏革任總督蔡毓榮經理十二堡，著有成效；
units.en: The emperor recalled that Sa Bu Su had once memorialized to dismiss Governor Cai Yurong from managing the twelve forts and that the change had worked well;
units.literal: The emperor noted that Sa Bu Su had once memorialized to dismiss Governor Cai Yurong from managing the twelve forts and that notable results had been achieved;

units.zh: 嗣因官堡荒棄，請停止屯種，將壯丁改歸驛站，存貯倉米，支放無餘，致駐防兵餉匱乏，責令回奏。
units.en: later he had asked to abandon the farms, shift men to courier stations, and draw down the granaries until garrison rations ran short—the emperor ordered him to explain.
units.literal: later because official forts were abandoned he asked to stop colony farming, transfer strong men to courier stations, store granary grain, disburse until none remained, causing garrison pay to be exhausted—the emperor ordered him to reply in a memorial.

units.zh: 薩布素具疏引罪，請以齊齊哈爾、墨爾根駐防兵每年輪派五百人往錫伯等處耕種官田，穫穀運齊齊哈爾交倉。
units.en: Sa Bu Su confessed fault and proposed rotating five hundred Qiqihar and Mergen garrison troops yearly to farm government fields among the Xibo, shipping the harvest to Qiqihar granaries.
units.literal: Sa Bu Su submitted a detailed memorial accepting guilt and requested that each year five hundred garrison troops from Qiqihar and Mergen be rotated to farm official fields among the Xibo and others, the harvest transported to Qiqihar and delivered to the granary.

units.zh: 詔侍郎滿丕等往按，以薩布素將荒廢地妄報成效，並浮支穀石，應斬，命罷任，奪世職，在佐領上行走。
units.en: Vice Minister Manpi investigated; Sa Bu Su was found to have falsely claimed results on abandoned land and overspent grain—for which death was warranted; he was dismissed, stripped of his hereditary rank, and reduced to assistant company command.
units.literal: An edict sent Vice Minister Manpi and others to investigate; because Sa Bu Su had falsely reported results on abandoned land and also disbursed grain beyond allowance, he deserved execution; he was ordered dismissed, stripped of his hereditary rank, and allowed to serve only at assistant company command.

units.zh: 尋授散秩大臣。
units.en: He was soon made minister without portfolio.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed minister without portfolio.

units.zh: 三十九年，卒。
units.en: In Kangxi 39 (1700) he died.
units.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he died.

units.zh: 乾隆間，敕修盛京通志，列名宦，且稱薩布素諳練明敏，得軍民心，其平羅剎及黑龍江興學，有文武幹濟才雲。
units.en: When the Shengjing gazetteer was revised in the Qianlong reign, he was listed among eminent officials and praised as experienced and sharp, beloved of troops and people, who pacified the Russians, founded Heilongjiang schools, and showed both civil and military talent.
units.literal: During Qianlong, when the Shengjing gazetteer was ordered revised, he was listed among eminent officials, and it was said that Sa Bu Su was experienced, clear, and keen, won the hearts of army and people, and in pacifying the Luosha and establishing schools in the Heilongjiang showed talent in both civil and military affairs.

units.zh: 瑪拉，那喇氏，滿洲鑲白旗人，尚書尼堪從子。
units.en: Ma La, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner and a nephew of Minister Nikan.
units.literal: Ma La, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner and a nephew of Minister Nikan.

units.zh: 尼堪卒，無子，瑪拉與叔阿穆爾圖、阿錫圖及弟兆資分襲尼堪世職，瑪拉襲三等阿達哈哈番。
units.en: When Nikan died childless, Ma La, his uncles Amurtu and Asitu, and his brother Zhaozi split Nikan's hereditary rank; Ma La inherited third-class ada hahapan.
units.literal: When Nikan died without sons, Ma La with his uncles Amurtu and Asitu and his younger brother Zhaozi divided inheritance of Nikan's hereditary rank; Ma La inherited third-class ada hahapan.

units.zh: 初任理籓院筆帖式。
units.en: He began as a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: He first served as a clerk in the Court of Colonial Affairs.

units.zh: 順治五年，英親王阿濟格徵叛將薑瓖，圍大同，令瑪拉調蒙古兵以從。
units.en: In Shunzhi 5 (1648) Prince Ying Ajige besieged Datong against rebel Jiang Xiang and ordered Ma La to raise Mongol troops for the campaign.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Shunzhi Prince Ying Ajige campaigned against the rebel general Jiang Xiang and besieged Datong; Ma La was ordered to mobilize Mongol troops to follow.

units.zh: 累遷理籓院副理事官。
units.en: He rose to associate director of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to associate director of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

units.zh: 康熙十四年，察哈爾布爾尼叛，聖祖命信郡王鄂扎帥師討之。
units.en: In Kangxi 14 (1675), when Chahar Burni rebelled, the Kangxi Emperor ordered Prince Xin Ezha against him.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi the Chahar Burni rebelled; the Sacred Ancestor ordered Prince Xin Ezha to lead troops against him.

units.zh: 瑪拉自陳久任理籓院習知蒙古狀，原赴軍前效力，遂命與員外郎色棱赴科爾沁諸部調選兵馬協剿。
units.en: Ma La volunteered that long service in the Court of Colonial Affairs had taught him Mongol affairs and asked to serve at the front; he and Department Director Seleng were sent to Khorchin to raise troops.
units.literal: Ma La stated that from long service in the Court of Colonial Affairs he was familiar with Mongol conditions and wished to serve at the front; he was therefore ordered, together with Department Director Seleng, to go to the Khorchin tribes to select troops and horses for the joint campaign.

units.zh: 師還，擢通政使，遷禮部侍郎。
units.en: After the campaign he became commissioner of the Office of Transmission and then vice minister of Rites.
units.literal: When the army returned he was promoted to commissioner of the Office of Transmission and transferred to vice minister of Rites.

units.zh: 十六年，擢工部尚書。
units.en: In Kangxi 16 (1677) he was made minister of Works.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year he was promoted to minister of Works.

units.zh: 偕內大臣喀岱往科爾沁諸外籓宣諭禁令。
units.en: With Inner Minister Kadai he proclaimed imperial prohibitions to the outer Khorchin banners.
units.literal: Together with Inner Minister Kadai he went to the outer Khorchin vassals to proclaim prohibitions.

units.zh: 瑪拉初受任，上誡以工部積弊，宜殫心釐剔。
units.en: On taking office the emperor warned him that the Ministry of Works was riddled with abuse and must be reformed with all his energy.
units.literal: When Ma La first received appointment the emperor admonished him that the Ministry of Works had long-standing abuses and that he should devote his heart to rectifying them.

units.zh: 十九年，坐不能清積弊，議降五秩，詔從寬留任。
units.en: In Kangxi 19 (1680) he was faulted for failing to clear abuses; demotion by five ranks was proposed but the emperor kept him in post.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, for failing to clear accumulated abuses, demotion by five ranks was proposed; an edict showed leniency and retained him in office.

units.zh: 復以饗殿器用修造疏忽，奪尚書，仍留世職。
units.en: Later, negligent repair of feast-hall vessels cost him the ministry but not his hereditary rank.
units.literal: Again, for negligent repair of vessels used in the feast hall, he was stripped of the ministry but retained his hereditary rank.

units.zh: 二十二年，上以俄羅斯數犯邊，擾及索倫、飛牙喀諸部，命集兵黑龍江，將進討，遣瑪拉往索倫儲軍實。
units.en: In Kangxi 22 (1683), with Russia raiding the border and harassing Solon and Feiyaka tribes, troops were massed on the Heilongjiang for an advance; Ma La was sent to Solon country to stock supplies.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year, because Russia repeatedly violated the border and harassed the Solon, Feiyaka, and other tribes, troops were ordered assembled on the Heilongjiang for an advance; Ma La was sent to the Solon to store military supplies.

units.zh: 尋疏言：「索倫總管博克所獲俄羅斯人及軍前招降者，皆迫於軍威，不宜久留索倫，應移之內地。」
units.en: He soon memorialized: "Russians taken by Solon commander Boke and those who surrendered to our army were coerced by force and should not remain in Solon country; move them inland."
units.literal: Shortly afterward he memorialized: "The Russians captured by Solon commander Boke and those who surrendered before the army were all compelled by military might and should not long remain among the Solon; they should be moved to the interior."

units.zh: 詔允行。
units.en: The court agreed.
units.literal: An edict approved.

units.zh: 復言：「雅克薩、尼布楚二城久為羅剎所據，臣密诇雅克薩惟耕種自給，尼布楚歲捕貂與喀爾喀貿易資養贍。
units.en: He added: "Albazin and Nerchinsk have long been Russian; reconnaissance shows Albazin lives by farming alone, while Nerchinsk depends on sable trade with the Khalkha.
units.literal: He further said: "The two cities of Yaksa and Nerchinsk have long been held by the Luosha; I secretly reconnoitered Yaksa and found they live only by farming for themselves; Nerchinsk each year hunts sable and trades with the Khalkha to support themselves.

units.zh: 請飭喀爾喀車臣汗禁所部與尼布楚貿易，並飭黑龍江將軍水陸並進，示將攻取雅克薩，因刈其田禾，則俄羅斯將不戰自困。」
units.en: I ask that the Khalkha Tsetsen Khan forbid trade with Nerchinsk, and that the Heilongjiang general advance by land and river, threaten Albazin, and cut their fields—the Russians will collapse without a battle."
units.literal: I request that the Khalkha Tsetsen Khan be ordered to forbid his people trade with Nerchinsk, and that the Heilongjiang General be ordered to advance by land and water, show intent to attack Yaksa, and cut their standing grain; then Russia will be trapped without fighting."

units.zh: 上然之，即以瑪拉所奏檄示喀爾喀。
units.en: The emperor agreed and sent Ma La's memorial to the Khalkha.
units.literal: The emperor approved and circulated Ma La's memorial to the Khalkha.

units.zh: 二十四年，遣都統朋春等帥師往黑龍江議進兵，授瑪拉副都統銜，參贊軍務。
units.en: In Kangxi 24 (1685) Lieutenant-General Peng Chun was sent to the Heilongjiang to plan the advance; Ma La received acting deputy lieutenant-general rank as staff adviser.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Lieutenant-General Peng Chun and others were dispatched to lead troops to the Heilongjiang to discuss the advance; Ma La was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general to assist in military affairs.

units.zh: 遣蒙古兵三十诇雅克薩城，生擒羅剎七人，得城中設備及乞援各部狀。
units.en: Thirty Mongol scouts reconnoitered Albazin, took seven Russians alive, and learned the town's defenses and appeals for aid.
units.literal: Thirty Mongol troops were sent to reconnoiter Yaksa city; seven Luosha were captured alive and the city's defenses and requests for aid from various tribes were learned.

units.zh: 是年夏，朋春等攻羅剎克之，逐其人。
units.en: That summer Peng Chun took the Russian post and expelled the garrison.
units.literal: That summer Peng Chun and others attacked the Luosha and took it, driving the people away.

units.zh: 瑪拉在事有功。
units.en: Ma La distinguished himself in the campaign.
units.literal: Ma La had merit in the affair.

units.zh: 二十五年，黑龍江佐領鄂色以耕牛多斃，農器損壞，奏請儲備，命瑪拉往黑龍江督理農務。
units.en: In Kangxi 25 (1686), when Heilongjiang Assistant Commander Ese reported dead oxen and broken tools and asked for reserves, Ma La was sent to supervise farming on the Heilongjiang.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Heilongjiang Assistant Commander Ese memorialized that many plow oxen had died and farm tools were damaged and requested reserves; Ma La was ordered to the Heilongjiang to supervise agriculture.

units.zh: 諭曰：「農事關軍餉，令嚴督合力播種。」
units.en: He was told: "Farming feeds the army—supervise sowing strictly and jointly."
units.literal: An instruction said: "Farming bears on army rations; order strict supervision and united sowing."

units.zh: 值歲豐，收穫甚稔。
units.en: The year was abundant and the harvest excellent.
units.literal: The year was abundant and the harvest very full.

units.zh: 二十七年，授護軍統領。
units.en: In Kangxi 27 (1688) he was made commandant of the guards.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was appointed commandant of the guards.

units.zh: 二十九年，噶爾丹侵掠喀爾喀，命瑪拉偕都統額赫納、前鋒統領碩鼐等率兵往討之，賜內廝馬以行。
units.en: In Kangxi 29 (1690), when Galdan raided the Khalkha, Ma La joined Lieutenant-General Ehena and Vanguard Commander Shuonai against him and received an imperial horse for the march.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year Galdan raided the Khalkha; Ma La was ordered, together with Lieutenant-General Ehena, Vanguard Commander Shuonai, and others, to lead troops against him and was granted horses from the imperial stables for the journey.

units.zh: 未幾，噶爾丹掠烏珠穆沁，命裕親王福全等分統大軍出塞擊之，噶爾丹敗遁。
units.en: Soon Galdan raided Ujimchin; Prince Yu Fuquan led the main army beyond the pass and drove him off.
units.literal: Before long Galdan raided Ujimchin; Prince Yu Fuquan and others were ordered to command the great army in separate divisions beyond the pass to strike him, and Galdan was defeated and fled.

units.zh: 師旋，三十年，復來犯，至阿爾哈賚，無所掠而遁。
units.en: After the army withdrew, in Kangxi 30 (1691) he invaded again to Arhakhai, found nothing to loot, and fled.
units.literal: When the army returned, in the thirtieth year he came again to invade, reached Arhakhai, found nothing to plunder, and fled.

units.zh: 時土謝圖汗、車臣汗率所部來歸，上幸塞外撫輯，瑪拉扈從。
units.en: When the Tüsiyetü and Tsetsen khans submitted with their peoples, the emperor went beyond the pass to receive them and Ma La attended.
units.literal: At that time the Tüsiyetü Khan and Tsetsen Khan led their tribes to submit; the emperor visited beyond the pass to comfort them and Ma La attended.

units.zh: 旋命偕都統瓦岱等率兵赴圖拉偵噶爾丹，抵克魯倫河，聞其遠竄，乃還。
units.en: He was then sent with Lieutenant-General Wadai to scout Galdan at Tüla, reached the Kerulen, heard Galdan had fled far off, and returned.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he was ordered, together with Lieutenant-General Wadai and others, to lead troops to Tüla to scout Galdan; they reached the Kerulen River, heard he had fled far away, and returned.

units.zh: 授西安將軍。
units.en: He was appointed general of Xi'an.
units.literal: He was appointed general of Xi'an.

units.zh: 三十二年，準噶爾和碩特部台吉巴圖爾額爾克濟農來降，上以其人未可信，命瑪拉徙入內地，毋令复逸。
units.en: In Kangxi 32 (1693) Dzungar Khoshut taiji Batur Erkejin came to surrender; the emperor considered his people not yet trustworthy and ordered Ma La to move them inland and prevent escape.
units.literal: In the thirty-second year the Dzungar Khoshut taiji Batur Erkejin came to surrender; the emperor considered his people not yet trustworthy and ordered Ma La to move them into the interior and not let them escape again.

units.zh: 瑪拉疏言：「巴圖爾額爾克濟農率所屬二千餘口，窮乏來歸，揆其情狀，當不復逸。」
units.en: Ma La reported: "Batur Erkejin brings more than two thousand followers who came in want and exhaustion; they are unlikely to flee again."
units.literal: Ma La memorialized: "Batur Erkejin leads more than two thousand followers who came in poverty and exhaustion; judging their condition, they should not flee again."

units.zh: 遂遣官護送，併其子台吉雲木春來朝，優賚遣之。
units.en: Officials escorted them; his son taiji Yunmuchun came to court and both were generously rewarded and sent home.
units.literal: Officials were then sent to escort them, and together with his son the taiji Yunmuchun they came to court and were generously rewarded and dismissed.

units.zh: 未幾，瑪拉卒於官，賜祭葬，諡敏恪。
units.en: He soon died in office, was granted state funeral honors, and received the posthumous name Minke.
units.literal: Before long Ma La died in office; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted and the posthumous title Minke was given.

units.zh: 論曰：俄羅斯之為羅剎，譯言緩急異耳，非必東部別有是名也。
units.en: The commentators note: calling Russia Luosha reflects only a difference in how the name is rendered in speech, not a separate eastern name.
units.literal: The commentary says: That Russia is called Luosha is only a difference in translation of quick and slow speech, not necessarily that the eastern region has another name.

units.zh: 初遣兵诇敵，郎坦主其事；
units.en: The first reconnaissance in force was led by Lang Tan;
units.literal: At first troops were sent to reconnoiter the enemy and Lang Tan directed the affair;

units.zh: 取雅克薩城，朋春、薩布素迭為將，而郎坦與瑪拉實佐之。
units.en: the capture of Albazin fell to Peng Chun and Sa Bu Su in succession as commanders, with Lang Tan and Ma La as the real staff behind them.
units.literal: in taking Yaksa city Peng Chun and Sa Bu Su served as generals in turn, while Lang Tan and Ma La in fact assisted.

units.zh: 尼布楚盟定，開市庫倫，是為我國與他國定約互市之始。
units.en: The Nerchinsk treaty and opening of trade at Khüree marked China's first treaty-bound trade with a foreign power.
units.literal: When the Nerchinsk treaty was fixed and trade was opened at Khüree, this was the beginning of our state's treaties and mutual trade with other countries.

units.zh: 用兵當期必克，我苟草率，彼益猖狂，聖祖諭薩布素數言，得馭夷之要矣。
units.en: Campaigns must be planned to win; rash action only emboldens the enemy—the Kangxi Emperor's words to Sa Bu Su capture the essence of managing foreign powers.
units.literal: In employing troops one must plan for certain victory; if we are rash, they grow more arrogant and reckless—the Sacred Ancestor's several instructions to Sa Bu Su grasp the essentials of controlling the barbarians.
